title: Microsoft.Entra/privilegedAccess/groupEligibilityScheduleRequests
description: A PIM for Groups eligibility: a user or group made eligible for the membership (accessId member) or ownership (accessId owner) of a group. The resource name is a deterministic GUID chosen with guid() (a label, not the identity); the eligibility is matched by (groupId, principalId, accessId) and read live on every run. Created with action adminAssign, changed in place with adminUpdate, removed with adminRemove; justification and ticketInfo are request metadata, sent on every request and never compared. The first request onboards the group in PIM for Groups permanently; dynamic membership and on-premises synced groups are refused.

groupId.description: The target group's object id (for example [reference(resourceId('Microsoft.Entra/groups', 'ops-admins')).id]), or use group. Not both.

group.description: EARM sugar: the target group's uniqueName or object id; resolved to groupId. Not with groupId.

principalId.description: Required: object id of the user or group made eligible.

accessId.description: Required: member (eligible membership) or owner (eligible ownership); any casing, sent in Graph's lowercase.

requestType.description: Optional and only AdminAssign (any casing); EARM chooses adminAssign / adminUpdate / adminRemove itself.

scheduleInfo.description: The eligibility period. Absent: permanent (expiration type NoExpiration), which a group's PIM policy may forbid.

startDateTime.description: ISO 8601 start; absent or in the past means now (a past start is never drift).

type.description: NoExpiration, AfterDateTime (needs endDateTime) or AfterDuration (needs duration); any casing, sent in Graph's camelCase.

endDateTime.description: AfterDateTime: the ISO 8601 end, after startDateTime. Compared with a 1 s tolerance.

duration.description: AfterDuration: an ISO 8601 duration such as P365D or PT8H. Applied when the eligibility is created and never compared afterwards.

justification.description: Request metadata, sent on every request and never compared (default "Deployed by earm"); PIM policy may require it.

ticketInfo.description: Request metadata, sent on every request and never compared.

permissions.notes: Learn (privilegedaccessgroup-post-eligibilityschedulerequests, privilegedaccessgroup-list-eligibilityschedules): PrivilegedEligibilitySchedule.ReadWrite.AzureADGroup is the least privileged permission for the requests (delegated and application); reads need PrivilegedEligibilitySchedule.Read.AzureADGroup. Delegated callers need Privileged Role Administrator for a role-assignable group; for other groups Identity Governance Administrator, Groups Administrator, Directory Writers or User Administrator suffice (or the caller owns the group); the permission manifest narrows the roles to Privileged Role Administrator for a role-assignable template group that groupId references and drops it for any other template group. Directory.Read.All covers the principal-kind check and the group uniqueName lookup. The first request onboards the group in PIM for Groups permanently. The tenant needs Microsoft Entra ID P2 or ID Governance.
